dynamic_line.gendered_line: My evac shelter got swarmed by some of those bees, the ones the size of dogs.  I took out a few with a plank, but pretty quick I realized it was either head for the hills or get stuck like a pig.  The rest is history.

//: TK: In a future iteration, this evacuee might give you directions to a hive.

dynamic_line.gendered_line: Yeah, I'm sure you've seen them, they're everywhere.  Like something out of an old sci-fi movie.  Some of the others in the evac shelter got stung, it was no joke.  I didn't stick around to see what the lasting effect was though.  I'm not ashamed to admit I ran like a <freaking> chicken.

responses.text: But bees aren't usually aggressive… do you mean wasps?
